messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Mix the powder form of this medicine with at least 4 ounces (one-half cup) of cold water or fruit juice before taking. Drink the mixture slowly, over 5 to 10 minutes in all. To make sure you get the entire dose, add a little more water to the same glass, swirl gently and drink right away.
To be sure this medicine is helping your condition, you may need frequent blood tests. You may not notice any change in your symptoms, but your blood work will help your doctor determine how long to treat you with potassium chloride. Your heart function may need to be checked using an electrocardiograph or ECG (sometimes called an EKG). Even if you have no symptoms, tests can help your doctor determine if this medicine is effective.
Your treatment may include a special diet. Follow the diet plan created for you by your doctor or nutrition counselor. Get familiar with the list of foods you should eat or avoid to help control your condition.

The relation 'has diet instruction' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject medication includes instructions for patients to follow a specific diet as part of their treatment plan.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'requires use of': The subject drug requires patients to use the specified product or practice to ensure safety or effectiveness.
B. 'requires patient to read': The patient is required to review the specified educational materials or documentation related to the medication.
C. 'has patient instruction': The subject drug combination includes instructions for patients on not sharing medications with others.
D. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
E. 'has missed dose instruction': If a dose of the subject drug is missed the patient should follow the instruction specified by the object entity.
